text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Vietnamese press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
-- The Asian Development Bank will provide a $120 million loan to upgrade Highway 1A linking Hanoi to the northern border province of Lang Son.
-- A Hanoi-Kunming passenger train service will begin operating on April 18.
-- Vietnam needs investment of about $11 billion for projects to produce and use gas and oil products for the domestic market.
-- Thailand's Prime Minister Chavalit Yongchaiyudh will visit Vietnam on March 30 and 31.
-- Two directors of leading trading firms in Ho Chi Minh City have been arrested on charges of complicity in the misappropriation of mortgaged assets.
-- Vice Prime Minister Phan Van Khai has called for the promotion of social insurance activities in Vietnam.
